body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0153 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "Disable Windows Defender via process - Behavior: Disable Windows Defender via process. Anchor is process+flag or event id+field after classic/XML coalesce. Not telemetry_validated. Sysmon 1 Set-MpPreference disable patterns"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0153"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1685"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINDOWS_SYSMON"
    ($e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\sc\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\net\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\powershell\.exe$/ nocase)
    ($e.target.process.command_line = /WinDefend/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /Sense/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /Set-MpPreference/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /DisableRealtimeMonitoring/ nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
